title: Matching service v0.3 - spec
text:
Author: **Daniel Ortiz** · Repo: pairly-api · Status: On staging
## Goal
Place every student in a study group of **3 to 5 people** within one minute of finishing onboarding.
## Signals
1. **Shared courses** - same course section scores higher than same course
2. **Overlapping free time** - at least two 1-hour slots in common each week
3. **Study style** - quiet, discussion, or exam cram
## Results on the Westbrook sample data
- 87% of students matched within one minute
- Average group size: 4.1
- Students with only one course: groups get too big (up to 8). Fix in progress.
## Performance
- Today: around 4 seconds per request when 200+ students match at the same time
- Target for launch: under 1 second
- Plan: group students by course first, then compare free time only inside each course
## Next version (v0.4, after launch)
- Smaller groups (3-4) for problem-set study
- Waiting list that retries matching every 6 hours
- Use library room availability if Westbrook gives us access
